reason: As a long-serving teller who doesn't want phone work, I'm more likely to give the move a fair hearing because A names what I'd lose (my branch and the members I know), says it wants to hear how we feel, and gives me a one-on-one meeting, a decision deadline and a Q&A. B's lead line, that no one loses their job, is reassuring, but it argues for the change more than it listens, and it leaves me with no clear next step.
